text:
Nora: Quick kickoff  sprint to ship a compact battlecard + routing CSV + 2 webinar slides for next week's launch. Focus: differentiation vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors.
Pri: Sales asks: one-line rebuttals + an exec hook + a demo step. Keep it copy-pastable.
Jin: Field patterns: 'we need stable p95 during promo spikes' and 'how to show cost math simply'.
Arman: Draft objection list I'm seeing: latency spikes, opaque pricing, slow rollouts, vendor lock-in, data governance.
Leah: For latency spikes: one-liner -> 'Dedicated pools + adaptive batching and KV caching keep p95 steady; automatic fallback preserves UX under bursts.'
Nora: Nice. Can we add a very short cost example (2 numbers) for the AE CSV?
Pri: Yes: 'Multi-tenant burst: $0.018/tk -> Dedicated w/ batching: $0.006/tk (example workload)'. We'll link to the benchmark artifact.
Jin: For rollouts: 'Pin model versions per-route, canary rollouts and instant rollback; we separate control plane from data plane for private deploys.' 1-liner for exec: 'Control without surprises.'
Arman: Webinar plan: slide A = benchmark snapshot (p50/p95/$ per MM tokens), slide B = demo script (trigger spike, show p95 and then flip to dedicated).
Leah: ops-bot: can you run short bench? bot-deploy: scheduled bench job: run/235901/llama2-70b-512. Artifacts will be at https://ci.redwood/bench/235901
Nora: CSV spec: columns = objection,rebuttal,proof_link,routing_tag,demo_instruction. Routing tags: infra, security, cost, latency.
Pri: Add a 30-40 word elevator (three variants) AEs can use at events. I'll draft.
Jin: Quick pasteable micro-rebuttal example:
```
Objection: "Why not ProviderX managed endpoints?"
Rebuttal: "Managed endpoints can show unpredictable tail latency in bursts. Redwood offers Dedicated pools, KV caching and model-variant fallback to keep p95s stable; Private for regulated data."
Proof: https://ci.redwood/bench/235901/p95.png
```
Arman: Good. Leah, can you make the AE demo steps super short (<=15 words) so they can run in 90s?
Leah: Sure: 'Start 10x QPS spike, show managed p95, flip to Dedicated, show stabilized p95.'
Nora: Timeline: CSV + one-pager by tomorrow noon; slides + bench artifacts prepped by tomorrow EOD. Who needs help?
Pri: I'll take the elevator variants and the exec blurbs.
Jin: I'll write the technical micro-rebuttals and produce the bench description for ops.
Arman: I'll assemble the CSV and hook it into inbound routing tags.
Leah: I'll coordinate the run and grab Grafana shots. bot-deploy: bench run completed: https://ci.redwood/bench/235901/artifacts/summary.json
Nora: Perfect. Once we have screenshots we'll swap in final numbers. Keep language terse  concise for AE usability.
Pri: Dropping drafts in #marketing-drafts in 30m.
Arman: CSV template uploaded to /marketing/ops/inbound-routing/battlecard-reroute-235901.csv
Nora: Thanks team  we'll iterate after the artifacts are live. :rocket:
